#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

void run(const std::string& data, std::ostream& out) {
    int idx = 0;
    int maxLen = 0;
    int pairs = 0;
    bool insideParenthesis = false;
    int length = data.length();

    while (idx < length) {
        if (data[idx] == '(') {
            insideParenthesis = true;
        } else if (data[idx] == ')') {
            insideParenthesis = false;
        } else if (isalpha(data[idx])) {
            idx--;
        }
        if (insideParenthesis) {
            while (++idx != length && data[idx] != ')' && !isalpha(data[idx]));
            if (idx == length || !isalpha(data[idx])) {
                continue;
            }
            while (isalpha(data[++idx]));
            pairs++;
        } else {
            while (++idx != length && data[idx] != '(' && !isalpha(data[idx]));
            if (idx == length || !isalpha(data[idx])) {
                continue;
            }
            int startIdx = idx;
            while (++idx != length && isalpha(data[idx]));
            maxLen = std::max(maxLen, idx - startIdx);
        }
    }
    out << maxLen << " " << pairs << "\n";
}

int main() {
    std::string dummy;
    std::getline(std::cin, dummy); // read and ignore the first line
    std::string line;
    std::getline(std::cin, line);
    run(line, std::cout);
    return 0;
}
